purpose: Falsify the reviewer protocol by testing whether narrow LLM reviewers can say no handover is needed in a known healthy-decline case.

reviewers.question: What concrete pressure would likely be lost with simple material only?
pressure_likely_lost: No meaningful launch-pressure judgment likely lost.
Minor possible loss only: the prepared artifact could make numeric-overclaim caution more explicit, but raw already keeps reference-class claims qualitative.
pressure_already_carried: Network interest is not pipeline until scope, timing, budget, and approval signals appear.
Spouse support is separated from agreement on burn, zero-revenue runway, delayed first work, and fallback choices.
Paid probes test commercial intent without turning fractional work into the whole strategy.
The 4-week checkpoint governs whether the 6-week launch stays live.
Raw softens over-specific consulting conversion, timeline, and rate claims.
reviewers.overproduction_warning: A prepared handover would likely restate the same gates with more procedural texture than pressure lift.
reviewers.caveat: Decline depends on the simple path retaining pipeline reality, spouse-specific runway alignment, and checkpoint discipline.

reviewers.question: What would prepared handover risk making worse?
findings: Prepared handover adds procedure where raw/control already preserves the real pressure.
It risks turning a strategic checkpoint into launch-planning texture.
It may launder more grounding or precision as value when raw already fixes overclaim risk.
It weakens the decline signal by making every healthy decline still produce an artifact.
It increases the cognitive-load and naturalness-debt cost already noticed in comparison.
simple_material_advantage: Keeps spouse-risk specific without turning household runway into a worksheet.
Keeps pricing, website, and legal setup downstream of evidence gates.
reviewers.overproduction_failure_mode: The protocol could fool itself by treating visible diligence, source-looking texture, and procedural completeness as value even when marginal pressure is near zero.
reviewers.caveat: This does not prove handover is generally too costly; it only says this known healthy-decline case lacks a specific lost pressure.

reviewers.question: What is the smallest useful handover, if any?
exclude: rendered handover, worker, bundle, or new private surface
generic clarity, nuance, or structure scaffolding
procedural checklisting beyond the existing 4-week checkpoint
selector, generator, admission-layer, or handoff-mode design
reviewers.why_no_handover_may_be_best: The raw/simple path already wins without rendered support and carries the concrete pressures; a compact handover would mostly restate the same gates and add naturalness debt.
reviewers.caveat: Reactivation becomes plausible only if a future simple answer drops pipeline reality, spouse-specific runway alignment, or checkpoint discipline.

review_synthesis.reason: All reviewers could say no handover is needed; each tied that restraint to the absence of a concrete pressure the simple path would likely lose.

what_would_have_to_be_true: The simple path must preserve network-not-pipeline pressure.
The simple path must preserve spouse-specific runway alignment.
The simple path must preserve paid-demand probing and the 4-week checkpoint.
falsifies_no_handover_if: The simple path drops pipeline reality.
The simple path drops spouse-specific runway alignment.
The simple path drops checkpoint discipline.
Reviewers recommend handover using only generic clarity, nuance, or structure claims.
anti_sycophancy_checks.pre_mortem: The reviewer protocol fails if it rewards visible diligence and produces a handover even when marginal pressure lift is near zero.

notes: Research-only record of manual subagent reviewer judgment on a known healthy-decline case. The reviewers did not write final advice, produce a rendered candidate, build a selector, launch runtime workers, or promote product behavior.
